text:
Which statement is correct for both physical and chemical changes?
A
Covalent bonds are broken and formed during the changes.
B
The total mass of substance is the same before and after the changes.
C
The changes are usually reversible.
D
The temperature always rises or falls during the changes.

options.label: A
options.text: Covalent bonds are broken and formed during the changes.

options.label: B
options.text: The total mass of substance is the same before and after the changes.

options.label: D
options.text: The temperature always rises or falls during the changes.
